title: draggable-layer-fix — the dragged card never hides: `.drag-source` loses to util `.flex`

set.request: the dragged card never hides: .drag-source (@layer theme, display:none) loses to util .flex (@layer util, display:flex) — set the source's inline style.display on drag start and restore it on drop/cancel, inline beats every layer
set.now: fix landed in Sortable.js (start()/end()) — proving with ui-test
steps: confirm the bug: where .drag-source is toggled (Sortable.start/end)
smallest fix: inline style.display=none on start, restore prior value on end
ui-test: prove computed display + column height before/after
verify Draggable page + Playground tree load with zero console errors
set.outcome:
**Fixed: the dragged source now actually hides — inline `style.display` beats the util-layer override that was beating `draggable.css`.**

`Sortable.start()` now writes `this.view.style("display", "none")` (via `View.style()`) right alongside `.ac("drag-source")`; `end()` restores whatever inline value was there before (`this.prior_display`, captured at `start()`). Four lines, `Sortable.js` only — `Draggable.js` and `draggable.css` untouched; the CSS rule stays as a harmless, correct default for any future caller that skips `Sortable`'s own toggle (reasoning in `doc/decisions.md`).

**Proof** (`ui-test` drive, `/framework/ext/Draggable/`, 1280x900):
- Mid-drag (right after `pointerdown`): `getComputedStyle(source).display` → **`"none"`**; `.drag-items` column height **217.23px before → 217.23px after** pointerdown (was 217 → 288px, +71px, before the fix).
- Reorder commits: `["Hold","Filter","Box"]` → `["Filter","Hold","Box"]`; `.drag-source` count back to 0 and column height back to 217.23px after drop.
- `/framework/ext/Draggable/` and `/framework/ui/tree/` load with zero console errors (also checked at 1600px, zero `.md-error`).

**Left:** nothing — brief fully closed. `readme.md` untouched: the fix removes a trap rather than creating a new one to warn callers about, so no Watch-out line earned its place.
